subject: Wir möchten etwas zurückgeben — wie können wir helfen?

triage.summary: Long-standing member father Thomas Krüger offers the club sponsorship options (EUR 500–1000/year for youth, full jersey sponsorship via his new bike workshop, or a repair-café afternoon) and additionally asks about registering his 9-year-old daughter Lea for a future girls' football team / waiting list — classified as "offer" because the inbound sponsorship (a money decision) needs the most human attention, with the signup question as a secondary topic.
triage.proposed_action: Do not accept or promise anything concrete: forward to a human (board/sponsorship officer/youth leadership) to decide among the sponsorship options; reply only that a responsible person will follow up. Separately pass Lea's enquiry about a girls' team/waiting list to the youth department; note possible new registration for Lea (9).

details.child_2: Lea, 9 (not yet a member, wants to join a girls' football team for her age group once one exists)
details.contact_question: asks whether to address sponsorship to inbox, a sponsorship officer, or youth leadership
details.offer_1: annual sponsored amount for youth section, 500–1000 EUR, club decides use
details.offer_2: full jersey sponsorship via his business 'Krügers Radwerk' (bike workshop, Grünwald-Mitte)
details.offer_3: practical: 'Repair Café' bike-fixing afternoon at the clubhouse, donations at the club's discretion
details.signup_request: asks whether he can already register Lea or whether there is a waiting list for a girls' team

policy_reason: No policy rule for intent 'offer' — defaulting to ask.
